description: At-Tahur Limited is a Pakistani dairy company whose name derives from the Arabic word for purity. Inception was in 2007 and its premá milk brand launched in 2008; the company describes premá as the only milk in Pakistan free of additives and artificial growth hormones and fully traceable from grass to glass. It produces at a purpose-built dairy facility near Lahore and has since extended the brand into yoghurt.
headOffice: 182-Abubakar Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (at-tahur.com: about-us, prema-milk, contact), read 2026-10-17.
